quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Keep right.
No U-turn.
Left lane must turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: How should you safely pass a bicycle?

options.text: Honk at the bicyclist to let them know you're coming.
Drive in the bicycle lane until you can pass.
Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
Speed up to pull in front of the bicyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: Slow down and give bicyclists as much space as you can. Bicycles have less protection than cars. Passing too quickly can push the bicyclist off course.

questions.question: What is important to remember when sharing the road with a truck?

options.text: Trucks need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles.
Trucks pass faster going downhill than smaller vehicles.
Trucks turn in a smaller space than smaller vehicles.
Trucks pass faster going uphill than smaller vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Trucks need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles.
questions.explanation: Because trucks are large and heavy, they need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: Right turn.
Intersection.
Lane change.
Road curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What do two solid yellow lines on the road mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is not allowed.
Passing is allowed at the top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during the day only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines show that traffic on the other side is moving toward you. Never cross two solid yellow lines to pass, from either direction.

questions.question: What do speed limit signs tell you?

options.text: The possible speeds for the area.
The highest or lowest speed that is legally allowed.
The speed to drive in heavy traffic.
The speed to drive in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest or lowest speed that is legally allowed.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the highest or lowest speed allowed on that road. The highest limits are for perfect conditions. You must slow down when weather or traffic is bad.

questions.question: You are waiting at a stop sign behind other vehicles. After the vehicles ahead go through and there is no other traffic, what must you do?

options.text: You can go through without stopping again.
You must stop at the stop sign or line before going through.
You can slowly roll past the stop sign.
You can follow the car ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop at the stop sign or line before going through.
questions.explanation: You must always make a complete stop at a stop sign and check for traffic before moving. Do not rush just because other cars are around you.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp, a driver should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the highway.
Have the right-of-way.
Force their way into traffic.
Assume other drivers will move for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the highway.
questions.explanation: When entering a highway on an entrance ramp, you must yield to vehicles already on the highway. Merge safely when there is space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the road curves right and then left. Be ready to adjust your speed and steering for the curves ahead.

questions.question: You are driving on a one-way street and see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights coming toward you. What must you do?

options.text: Turn on your flashers.
Drive to the nearest side of the road and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the nearest side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with lights is coming on a one-way street, move to the nearest side of the road and stop.

questions.question: What can a driver do to prevent accidents on long trips?

options.text: Stop every couple of hours to rest.
Avoid medicine that makes you drowsy.
Drive no more than 300-400 miles per day.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent accidents from drowsy driving on long trips, stop every couple of hours to rest and stretch. Drive no more than 300-400 miles per day. Get a good night's sleep before you leave and avoid medicine that makes you drowsy.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic.
Divided highway ahead.
Two-way traffic.
Keep left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Bicycle crossing.
Stop only if other cars are approaching.
Bicycle store.
Soft shoulders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride next to traffic. Drive slowly and carefully in this area because you may see bicycles.

questions.question: Drivers cannot pass from either side of a ____ centerline.

options.text: Combination solid and broken yellow
Single broken yellow
Double solid yellow
Single broken white

questions.correctAnswerText: Double solid yellow
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means no traffic from either direction can cross the center to pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
No left turn.
Merge.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What happens when a driver is distracted?

options.text: It is never dangerous.
The driver reacts more slowly to hazards.
The driver usually drives faster.
It is only dangerous for young drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver reacts more slowly to hazards.
questions.explanation: When drivers are distracted, they respond more slowly to traffic and road hazards. Distracted driving is always dangerous.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:

options.text: Flat.
Curvy.
In the sun.
Shaded.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded.
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, shaded areas freeze faster than other parts of the road. Trees and buildings create shade. These areas freeze first and dry last. Be extra careful in shaded areas.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass even if it is dangerous.
Lanes move in opposite directions.
You may not pass.
You may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. Dashed white lines can be crossed to pass or change lanes when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does an arrow painted on the pavement mean?

options.text: Drivers in that lane may make the move shown, if they want to.
Drivers in that lane must make the move shown only if traffic lights are broken.
Drivers in that lane must always stop before making the move shown.
Drivers in that lane must make the move shown while obeying traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in that lane must make the move shown while obeying traffic signals.
questions.explanation: An arrow painted on the pavement tells drivers in that lane what direction they must go. Always follow traffic signs and signals before moving in the direction the arrow shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians only.
Intersection ahead.
Hiking trails ahead.
School crossing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: School crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: You notice a vehicle defect that could affect safe driving. What should you do?

options.text: Fix it as soon as possible.
Fix it when you have enough money.
Drive at slower speeds.
Drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fix it as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Fix any defect that affects safe driving right away. Do not drive the vehicle until it is fixed.

questions.question: Fog reduces visibility of other vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signals. What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Drive carefully and reduce your speed.
Do not use high beam headlights.
Use low beam headlights to see the road better.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: In fog, drive slowly and carefully. Do not use high beams. Use low beams instead — they help you see the road and objects ahead better in fog.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the road centerline mean?

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass vehicles in the other direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic.
Intersection ahead.
Traffic merging from the right.
Road curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will enter the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways before crossing.
Come to a complete stop at all times.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Only stop if traffic makes it necessary.

questions.question: When turning right, your car should be positioned:

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection when turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Move to the far right side of the road before turning right. Do not cut across other lanes to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic.
Two-way left turn.
Two-way traffic.
Minimum speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: One-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: If you get stranded in a snowstorm, what should you do?

options.text: Leave the car and go find help.
Lie down in the car and sleep.
Walk into the road to get other drivers' attention.
Stay in the car — rescue crews will find you more easily.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the car — rescue crews will find you more easily.
questions.explanation: Stay inside your car and wait for help. You are more likely to be found if you do not leave your vehicle. Walking in a snowstorm is dangerous.

questions.question: If your wheels drop off the road onto the shoulder, what should you do?

options.text: Brake hard and turn sharply back onto the road.
Stop your car on the road edge.
Slow down and carefully turn back onto the road.
Keep your speed and turn sharply back onto the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and carefully turn back onto the road.
questions.explanation: Reduce speed without slamming the brakes. Carefully steer back onto the road. Watch for other traffic.

questions.question: You reach an intersection where you want to turn, but you are in the wrong lane. What should you do?

options.text: Quickly cut across traffic to make the turn.
Turn on your signal and turn from your current lane.
Drive to the next intersection and turn there.
Change lanes safely, then back up to the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the next intersection and turn there.
questions.explanation: Never make last-minute turns. Drive to the next intersection and turn from the correct lane.

questions.question: When can a driver legally pass on the right side of another vehicle?

options.text: When the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
Even if you have to drive off the pavement.
On a narrow bridge.
At any time.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right when there is a passing lane and the vehicle ahead is turning left or waiting to turn left. You may also pass on the right on a multilane road with two or more lanes going the same direction. Never drive off the pavement to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: Which statement about passing is true?

options.text: Signal at least 100 feet before changing lanes to pass. Make sure there is no oncoming traffic.
Use your mirrors and look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot before passing to the left.
Wait until you see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror before moving back to your original lane.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Always signal at least 100 feet before you change lanes to pass. Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Wait until you can see both headlights of the car you passed in your rearview mirror before returning to your original lane.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: Merging traffic
Drive with caution.
Pedestrian crossing
Come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow traffic light means you should drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars following too closely.
Move when the vehicle in front of you moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, look left first because traffic from the left is closer to you. Then look right. Finally, look left again to check for any vehicles you may have missed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: U-turns are not allowed.
U-turns are allowed.
Winding road ahead.
Sharp left turn ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: U-turns are not allowed.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. When you see this sign, U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: You should drive below the posted speed limit when:

options.text: Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
You see a police car.
Entering a highway with other cars.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
questions.explanation: Drive below the speed limit when the road is wet, slippery, or when visibility is poor. You can be ticketed for speeding even if you are driving at the posted limit if conditions are unsafe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a detour ahead.
You must stop for flaggers.
The road ahead is closed.
Construction work is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction work is ahead.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction or maintenance work. This sign tells you to slow down and drive carefully through the work area ahead.
